curriculum.name: Kenya Competency-Based Curriculum (CBC)
curriculum.tagline: Practical, value-driven, KICD-aligned learning for Kenyan families
curriculum.description: Approved by KICD for Pre-Primary Early Years Education (PP1 & PP2).

term_package.title: PP1 CBC - Term 1 Early Years Activity Box
term_package.subtitle: KICD Early Years Aligned: Language, Math Activities, Environmental, Psychomotor & Creative Arts
features: 12 Weeks of Play-Based Sensory & Pre-Literacy Lessons
Phonics & Letter Sound Recognition with Household Items
Pre-Number Sorting, Counting & Color Discovery Activities
Weekly Sunday Printable Color Activity Sheets

lessons.subject: Language Activities
lessons.topic: Oral Expression: My Name and Greeting
lessons.parent_script: Greet your child: Habari ya asubuhi! Tell me your full name with a big smile!
lessons.learning_objective: Learner introduces themselves clearly and practices polite greetings.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Look in mirror together.
2. Say My name is [Child].
3. Practice shaking hands.

lessons.subject: Mathematical Activities
lessons.topic: Sorting Everyday Objects by Color (Red & Blue)
lessons.parent_script: Collect red and blue bottle caps from our kitchen basket.
lessons.learning_objective: Sort at least 6 household items into red and blue bowls accurately.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Place caps in mixed pile.
2. Pick red into red basin.
3. Count each color.

lessons.subject: Environmental Activities
lessons.parent_script: Sing the 20-second bubbly handwashing song while rubbing palms and fingers!
lessons.learning_objective: Demonstrate the 5 steps of proper hygienic handwashing.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Wet hands.
2. Lather soap for 20s.
3. Rinse thoroughly and dry.
